summary: Verified double-buy prevention (HTTP 409) on all 3 checkout endpoints + regression for fresh free users + idempotent mock-unlock + methods/availability endpoints + frontend Pricing UI for lifetime user. 11/11 backend tests pass. Frontend confirmed shows 'YOU'RE A LIFER' disabled button and PayPal-unavailable notice.

ui_bugs.issue: For a lifetime user the free-plan CTA button reads 'You're on Free' (mislabelled). It's disabled correctly but the copy should say 'You're on Lifetime' or similar. Pre-existing, unrelated to current change.

critical_code_review_comments: Guards implemented correctly and in the right order: /billing/checkout, /billing/razorpay/order, /billing/paypal/order all check user.plan == 'lifetime' BEFORE any external gateway lookup or availability check — verified via test that PayPal returns 409 (not 503) for a lifetime user.
mock-unlock is now idempotent: {ok:true, already:true} for lifetime users with no DB write.
Frontend unlock() correctly: (a) early-returns for lifetime user with success toast + /dashboard redirect, (b) catches HTTP 409 in shared error handler and shows success toast + refresh + redirect.
Minor: free-card CTA label doesn't distinguish free vs lifetime users (shows 'You're on Free' for lifetime users too).
test_credentials: test1@ughpdf.com / testpass123 (existing lifetime); fresh users created via /api/auth/signup in-test.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 disposable test users (life_*, free_*, rzpfree_*, ppfree_*, mock_*) via signup during tests. All isolated with unique uuid emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_double_buy_prevention.py provides regression coverage for the lifetime-409 guard across all 3 gateways. Existing test_ughpdf_backend.py still covers full app surface (56+ tests).
